name: nine-gyo-phi
description: A private, local-first document reader and audiobook studio for desktop platforms

scripts.lint: eslint src/static/{app,audio,core,parser,storage,neural-worker,speech}.js scripts tests/frontend && prettier --check src/index.html src/static/{app.css,app.js,audio.js,core.js,parser.js,storage.js,neural-worker.js,speech.js} scripts tests/frontend && npm run lint:docs
scripts.check:desktop: cargo fmt --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run verify:assets && npm audit --audit-level=moderate && npm run check:desktop && npm run test:desktop
